kernel.governing_law: A single resourceful agent narrates acquiring, consuming, and distributing intoxicants and language across a named locality, treating each score, each hit, each bar as a discrete countable event under personal control — the street as vending machine, the self as its operator.
kernel.mutated_relation: The circulation itself — substance, sound, slang, sugar, stimulant — is the continuous distributed process; every "I found," "I sank," "I blew" is only where the current briefly registers a node, the way a river notes a rock.
